description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Gross Yield' headline figure in the Market
section.

Gross rental yield = median weekly rent x 52 / median sale price, as a
decimal fraction (0.0335 = 3.35%), for houses and units separately.
Each value carries its own date (`house_as_of`, `unit_as_of`).

**Price: 5¢ per call.**
name: suburbs_market_yield_pct
